knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A visual inspection records what is seen from a safe position and does not establish concealed safety.

The lesson says each finding that needs work becomes a line in a proposed scope showing the observation, the risk level, the proposed action, the owner of the action, and whether a specialist is needed.

passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Photograph from a safe permitted location; document water presence and urgency; request a qualified building or roofing inspection without asserting a cause.
Describe the responsible referral and documentary trail
stopWorkCriteria: Entering unsafe roof space or claiming a structural diagnosis.
